item.title: Evening Weather for Wednesday, September 02
item.description: Good evening! Welcome to your weather report for Wednesday, September 2. It's Wednesday, right in the middle of the week. Here in Shanghai, the day will be rumbling with thunderstorms. It will reach 29 degrees, and drop down to 24 degrees. There is a 92 percent chance of rain. Don't forget your umbrella today! Take your raincoat with you. Splashing is allowed! And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be drizzly, with a high of 30 degrees. Here's a question: if you could invent a new weather, what would it be like? That's all from the weather desk. Enjoy your day!
